This scene:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国：delete一天；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜：wrong information, it’s not his mother’s job
- 孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家：delete因为

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他说我们老是搬家，为什么？：他说：“我们为什么老是搬家？”，A direct question following a speaking verb should be introduced with a colon and quotation marks; placing the question word before the statement makes the question clear. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。：他妈妈说：“从早到晚，我一直祭拜，我得祭拜很多墓地。”，A modal verb such as 得 follows its subject and comes before the main verb; the original order incorrectly makes the graves appear before the person who must do the action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他妈妈：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，On first mention, introduce the character with both a description and a name; after that introduction, the pronoun can refer clearly to him. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: “他说我们老是搬家，为什么？” is an acceptable way to report his question, although the direct-quotation version is also correct.
“很多墓地得我祭拜” can mean that many graves are ones he must worship, so its word order is not necessarily erroneous.
The teacher requires a brief introduction when 孟子 first appears, but the displayed replacement is only a fragment and lacks the rest of the clause.
